articles.title: Sweet Discovery: Raspberry Sugar Found Near Milky Way's Center
articles.summary: A sugar found in raspberries was discovered in a gas cloud near the Milky Way's center. It suggests life's ingredients are common in space.

articles.title: America's 250th Birthday Time Capsule: A Message to the Future
articles.summary: A time capsule buried on July 4, 2026, in Philadelphia contains items from all 50 states. It will be opened in 2276.

articles.title: Tesla Announces Wheelchair-Accessible Robotaxi in Development
articles.summary: Tesla says it's building a wheelchair-accessible self-driving car. No US robotaxi company currently offers this.
